seed_source.description: List of URLs or file:// paths to fetch seeds from (e.g., https://ubuntu-archive-team.ubuntu.com/seeds/, file:///home/user/seeds/).

seed_dist.description: Distribution name for seeds (e.g., ubuntu.trixie, debian.stable).

mirror.description: List of mirror URLs for binary package indices (e.g., http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/).

source_mirror.description: List of mirror URLs for source package indices. Defaults to using binary mirrors if not set.

dist.description: List of distributions to process (e.g., trixie, trixie-updates).

components.description: List of components to include (e.g., main, universe, restricted).

vcs.description: Version control system to use for seed checkout: 'auto', 'bzr', or 'git'.

apt_config.description: Path to APT config file to override mirror/dist/components settings.

no_rdepends.description: Disable reverse-dependency calculations (skip generating rdepends/ directory).

no_installer.description: Exclude debian-installer udeb packages from consideration.

always_follow_build_depends.description: Always follow Build-Depends, ignoring seed-specific feature flags.

seed_packages.description: List of 'parent/seed-pkg' pairs to treat as extra seeds inheriting from parent.
